lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 3 ||
lines.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਵਨੁ ਈਹਾ ਜਗਿ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: koee jaanai kavan eehaa jag meet ||
lines.translation: Does anyone know, who is our friend in this world?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis hoi kripaal soee bidh boojhai taa kee niramal reet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He alone understands this, whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy. Immaculate and unstained is his way of life. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਇਸਟ ਮੀਤ ਅਰੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maat pitaa banitaa sut ba(n)dhap isat meet ar bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Mother, father, spouse, children, relatives, lovers, friends and siblings meet,

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਅੰਤਹਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: poorab janam ke mile sa(n)jogee a(n)tahi ko na sahaaee ||1||
lines.translation: Having been associated in previous lives; but none of them will be your companion and support in the end. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਮਾਲ ਕਨਿਕ ਲਾਲ ਹੀਰਾ ਮਨ ਰੰਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukat maal kanik laal heeraa man ra(n)jan kee maaiaa ||
lines.translation: Pearl necklaces, gold, rubies and diamonds please the mind, but they are only Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾ ਹਾ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ਅਵਧਹਿ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: haa haa karat bihaanee avadhahi taa mahi sa(n)tokh na paaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: Possessing them, one passes his life in agony; he obtains no contentment from them. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਸਤਿ ਰਥ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਪਵਨ ਤੇਜ ਧਣੀ ਭੂਮਨ ਚਤੁਰਾਂਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: hasat rath asv pavan tej dhanee bhooman chaturaa(n)gaa ||
lines.translation: Elephants, chariots, horses as fast as the wind, wealth, land, and armies of four kinds

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਿਓ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਛੂਐ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਇਓ ਨਾਂਗਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)g na chaalio in mahi kachhooai ooth sidhaaio naa(n)gaa ||3||
lines.translation: - none of these will go with him; he must get up and depart, naked. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke sa(n)t pri preetam prabh ke taa kai har har gaaeeai ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Saints are the beloved lovers of God; sing of the Lord, Har, Har, with them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak eehaa sukh aagai mukh oojal sa(n)g sa(n)tan kai paaeeai ||4||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, in the Society of the Saints, you shall obtain peace in this world, and in the next world, your face shall be radiant and bright. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 3 dupade ||
lines.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Third House, Dho-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਸੰਦੇਸਰੋ ਕਹੀਅਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕਹੀਅਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dehu sa(n)desaro kaheeau pri kaheeau ||
lines.translation: Give me a message from my Beloved - tell me, tell me!

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮੁ ਭਈ ਮੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੁਨਤੇ ਕਹਹੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਸਹੀਅਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bisam bhaee mai bahu bidh sunate kahahu suhaagan saheeau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am wonder-struck, hearing the many reports of Him; tell them to me, O my happy sister soul-brides. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋ ਕਹਤੋ ਸਭ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਕਹਤੋ ਸਭ ਮਹੀਅਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ko kahato sabh baahar baahar ko kahato sabh maheeau ||
lines.translation: Some say that He is beyond the world - totally beyond it, while others say that He is totally within it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਰਨੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਸਾਤਿ ਬੁਝਹੀਅਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: baran na deesai chihan na lakheeai suhaagan saat bujhaheeau ||1||
lines.translation: His color cannot be seen, and His pattern cannot be discerned. O happy soul-brides, tell me the truth! ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਸੀ ਲੇਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਅਲਪਹੀਅਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab nivaasee ghat ghat vaasee lep nahee alapaheeau ||
lines.translation: He is pervading everywhere, and He dwells in each and every heart; He is not stained - He is unstained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਲੋਗਾ ਸੰਤ ਰਸਨ ਕੋ ਬਸਹੀਅਉ ॥੨॥੧॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kahat sunahu re logaa sa(n)t rasan ko basaheeau ||2||1||2||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, listen, O people: He dwells upon the tongues of the Saints. ||2||1||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaitasaree mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੀਰਉ ਸੁਨਿ ਧੀਰਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dheerau sun dheerau prabh kau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am calmed, calmed and soothed, hearing of God. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਨੀਰਉ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਨੀਰਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jee praan man tan sabh arapau neerau pekh prabh kau neerau ||1||
lines.translation: I dedicate my soul, my breath of life, my mind, body and everything to Him: I behold God near, very near. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਬਡ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਗਹੀਰਉ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: besumaar bea(n)t bad daataa manahi gaheerau pekh prabh kau ||2||
lines.translation: Beholding God, the inestimable, infinite and Great Giver, I cherish Him in my mind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਉ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਵਉ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਉ ਜਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jo chaahau soee soee paavau aasaa manasaa poorau jap prabh kau ||3||
lines.translation: Whatever I wish for, I receive; my hopes and desires are fulfilled, meditating on God. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਦੂਖਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਝੂਰਉ ਬੁਝਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaad naanak man vasiaa dookh na kabahoo jhoorau bujh prabh kau ||4||2||3||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, God dwells in Nanak's mind; he never suffers or grieves, having realized God. ||4||2||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋੜੀਦੜਾ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: loReedaRaa saajan meraa ||
lines.translation: I seek my Friend the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨੀਕੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar ghar ma(n)gal gaavahu neeke ghat ghat tisahi baseraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In each and every home, sing the sublime songs of rejoicing; He abides in each and every heart. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖਿ ਅਰਾਧਨੁ ਦੂਖਿ ਅਰਾਧਨੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sookh araadhan dookh araadhan bisarai na kaahoo beraa ||
lines.translation: In good times, worship and adore Him; in bad times, worship and adore Him; do not ever forget Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਰ ਉਜਾਰਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam japat kot soor ujaaraa binasai bharam a(n)dheraa ||1||
lines.translation: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the light of millions of suns shines forth, and the darkness of doubt is dispelled. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਾਨਿ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸਭਨੀ ਜਾਈ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar sabhanee jaaee jo deesai so teraa ||
lines.translation: In all the spaces and interspaces, everywhere, whatever we see is Yours.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੩॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g paavai jo naanak tis bahur na hoee hai pheraa ||2||3||4||
lines.translation: One who finds the Society of the Saints, O Nanak, is not consigned to reincarnation again. ||2||3||4||
